title: grok pager appearance
description: The grok TUI appearance file, `$GROK_HOME/pager.json`. Every member is optional. An absent or `null` member keeps the built-in default.

scrollback.description: Scrollback pane settings (layout, scrollbar, scroll, blocks).

disable_plugins.description:
Disable hooks & plugins UI (/hooks and /plugins commands, scrollback annotations).
Defaults to false (plugins enabled).

show_plan_chip.description:
Always show the "plan" chip in the status bar when plan content is
available, even after the user exits plan mode.
Defaults to false (chip hidden once plan mode ends).

alt_screen.description: "auto" (default): fullscreen except tmux control mode and Zellij. "always" / "never" force the choice.

minimal.description:
Experimental scrollback-native rendering mode. Finalized blocks are
printed into the terminal's native scrollback. Default false.

minimal_live_rows.description: Pinned live-region height (rows) for minimal mode. Default 10.

minimal_max_commit_rows.description: Maximum rows for a single committed block in minimal mode. Default 2000.

minimal_collapse_thinking.description: Opt out of minimal's full reasoning body (K9). Collapsed header only; body stays reachable via expand/transcript.

RawTerminalConfig.description: Fullscreen (alternate screen) policy and related terminal settings.

oneOf.description: Automatic: fullscreen in healthy environments, inline in degraded ones.

fps.description:
Animation frame rate (ticks per second).
Higher = smoother but more CPU. Range: 1-60. Default: 30.

wave_rows.description:
Rows per wave cycle for accent line animation.
Lower = faster wave, higher = slower/smoother wave. Default: 32.

show_fps.description:
Show an FPS counter overlay in the top-right corner.
Requires a debug build. Also enabled by GROK_FPS=1 env var. Default: false.

collapse_unfocused.description:
When true, the prompt collapses to its minimum height (single-line)
when focus is in the scrollback pane. Expands back when focused.

mouse_hover.description: Show hover highlight box when mousing over the prompt widget.

show_prefix.description: Show the ❯ prefix character in the prompt editor.

RawPromptViewConfig.description: Prompt editor widget, not the user prompt block in scrollback.

outer_hpad_left.description: Left horizontal padding for outer viewport (min 1).

outer_hpad_right.description: Right horizontal padding for outer viewport (min 1).

block_pad_left.description: Padding after accent line, before content.

block_pad_right.description: Padding after content, at right edge.

gap_left.description:
Gap between content/selection edge and scrollbar track.
0 = adjacent to content, 1+ = space between.
Note: Content width is clamped to outer_hpad boundaries.

gap_right.description:
Gap between scrollbar track and screen edge.
0 = scrollbar at screen edge (uses outer_hpad_right if available).

scrollbar_bg.description:
Override scrollbar background color.
Use "none" to use theme default, or a color value.

scrollbar_fg.description:
Override scrollbar foreground/thumb color.
Use "none" to use theme default, or a color value.

Color.description: A color: "none" for the theme default, a hex string ("#7aa2f7" or "#f7f"), an RGB array ([122, 162, 247]), or a color name. Names are case-insensitive: BG, BG_BASE, BG_LIGHT, BG_HIGHLIGHT, BG_DARK, BG_TERMINAL, BG_NIGHT, BG_VISUAL, BG_SEARCH, BLUE, BLUE0, BLUE1, BLUE2, BLUE5, BLUE6, BLUE7, CYAN, GREEN, GREEN1, GREEN2, YELLOW, ORANGE, RED, RED1, MAGENTA, PURPLE, MAGENTA2, TEAL, HINT, FG, TEXT, TEXT_PRIMARY, FG_DARK, TEXT_SECONDARY, FG_GUTTER, COMMENT, MUTED, TEXT_MUTED, DARK3, DARK5, TOOL, ERROR, SUCCESS, WARNING, INFO, BLACK, WHITE, GRAY, GREY.

margin.description:
Minimum lines of context to keep above/below selected entry.
When navigating, ensure at least this many lines of adjacent entries
remain visible. 0 = scroll to edge (default).

min_page_fraction.description:
Minimum scroll as percentage of viewport height (0-100).
If a scroll would be less than this percentage, scroll by this amount instead.
0 = minimal scroll (default), 25 = quarter page, 100 = full page.

follow_indicator.description:
Scroll indicators: the ▼ below scrollback and the ▲ under the sticky
prompt header. "none" = hidden, "center" = centered arrows.

follow_auto_select.description: When follow mode scrolls to new content, auto-select the latest entry.

follow_by_overscroll.description: Scrolling past the bottom (j, Ctrl-D, page-down, mousewheel) engages follow mode.

anchor_on_fold.description: Anchor scroll on fold: keep the toggled block's header at the same screen y. Default: true.

respect_manual_folds.description:
Opt-in: keep manually folded blocks as-is during streaming and when they finish,
and stop auto-scroll when a fold expands a block while following. Default: false.

oneOf.description: Show ▼ centered below scrollback and ▲ under the sticky prompt header.

tool.description: Tool call block settings (Read, Search, ListDir, etc).

indent.description: Whether to apply 2-char indent before line numbers.

accent_bg.description: Whether to show background behind accent.

accent.description: Vertical-line accent. "none" disables. Accepts RGB, hex, or a named color.

gutter_bg.description: Whether diff line background extends to include gutter (line numbers).

indent_bg.description:
Whether to skip indent columns in diff line background (keep them clean).
true = skip indent, false = include indent in background.

line_summary.description: Show the +N/-M line summary in the collapsed header. Unset follows `ui.collapsed_edit_blocks`.

expanded_by_default.description:
Unset follows `ui.collapsed_edit_blocks`. A true flag collapses even when this is true.
An explicit false still collapses when the flag is off.

dual_line_numbers.description:
Show two line-number columns (old + new) like GitHub's unified diff.
When false (default), show a single column with the new-file line number.

vpad.description: Whether to apply vertical padding (blank lines above/below).

accent_bg.description: Whether accent column gets block's background.

min_lines.description:
Minimum content lines to show in truncated/sticky header mode.
This is the number of actual content lines, not including vpad.

show_prefix.description: Show the ❯ prefix character before the prompt text.

RawPromptConfig.description: User prompt block in scrollback, not the prompt editor widget.

accent.description:
Accent color for the vertical line.
Use "default" (or "none") for theme default, or a named/hex/RGB color.

accent_enabled.description: Whether accent line is shown. Set to false to hide accent in all modes.

bg_blend.description:
Blend factor for markdown colors with background (0-100).
Lower values = more faded. 70 = 70% original color, 30% background.

truncated_lines.description:
Number of visual lines to show at start and end in truncated mode.
If content exceeds this, shows first N lines, ellipsis, last N lines.

animate.description:
Whether the accent line animates (traveling wave) while thinking is active.
When false, the accent line is static.

header.description:
Show header line in truncated/expanded modes.
When true: "Thinking..." (running) or "Thought for Xs" (done) appears
as the first line above thinking content, with accent line and bullet.

header_bright.description:
When true, header uses brighter styling in non-collapsed modes (like tool titles).
Respects muted_collapsed when collapsed. When false, header is always dim gray.

muted_collapsed.description:
When true, collapsed tool calls render entirely in muted gray.
When false, collapsed tool calls show normal colors.

dim_details.description:
When true, parenthetical details use the dimmest gray (gray_dim):
Read "(1-50)", Search "(N matches)", Edit "(N edits)", Thinking "for Xs".
When false, they use the normal muted gray.

terminal_bg.description:
When true, output has terminal-style dark background.
When false, output has no background.

first_lines.description:
Number of output lines to show at the start in truncated mode.
In truncated mode: first_lines, then "…", then last_lines.

last_lines.description: Number of output lines to show at the end in truncated mode.

accent_enabled.description:
Whether accent line is shown. Set to false to hide all accents
(running/success/error).

running_accent.description:
Accent color for running execute blocks (animated wave).
Default: MAGENTA. Use named colors, hex, or RGB array.

header_style.description:
Header display style: "shell" = `$ command`, "label" = `Run command` (default).
Shell style shows a dim `$` prompt. Label style shows bold "Run" like Edit/Search.

muted_command_collapsed.description:
When true, command text is muted/uncolored when collapsed.
When false, command text keeps its color when collapsed.

RawExecuteConfig.description: Configuration for Execute tool call block.

line_under_last_entry.description: Render a subtle horizontal line below the last entry ("end of content" marker).

collapsed_accent_char.description: Accent character for collapsed groupable blocks. Default: "❙" ("|" on the Windows console).

dim_accent.description: Blend factor for dimmed accents on collapsed groupable blocks (0.0–1.0). Default: 0.5.

group_selection_split.description: Group selection box mode. true = "split" (Mode B), false = "always" (Mode A). Default: true.

highlight_overlays_border.description: Whether active-block highlight overlays selection box borders. Default: false.

expandable_indicator.description: Show expand indicator (e.g., "›") on selected foldable collapsed entries. Default: true.

expandable_indicator_running.description: Show expand indicator on running entries in their minimum fold mode. Default: true.

expandable_indicator_char.description: Character for the expand indicator. Default: "›".

selection_buttons.description: Show ⧉/↗ buttons on the selection box. Default: false.

sticky_headers.description: Pin user prompts as sticky headers when scrolled past. Default: true.

tab_width.description:
Number of spaces to use when expanding tab characters (\t) in content.
Tabs in model output are replaced with this many spaces before rendering.
Default: 4. Set to 0 to pass through tabs unchanged.

group_max_visible.description:
Maximum visible entries in a consecutive group of collapsed tool/thinking blocks.
Older entries are hidden behind a compact header. 0 = disable. Default: 10.

rtl_bidi.description:
App-side RTL bidi reordering for scrollback. Default false (terminals often
already reorder; enabling both double-flips Arabic/Persian).
